programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick duda entre entregarle o no a Michonne al Gobernador y poner así fin a la contienda. Sin embargo, Merle se anticipa a las órdenes de Rick y decide tomar una decisión por su propia cuenta.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador y sus hombres lanzan un ataque contra la prisión, pero el grupo de Rick se defiende. Al final de la contienda, solo una de las dos comunidades podrá seguir existiendo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los supervivientes de Woodbury se han unido al grupo de Rick en la prisión, crían animales, cultivan y todo parece ir bien. Sin embargo, el grupo va a descubrir que el peligro no siempre llega desde afuera.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick establece una cuarentena para evitar que el virus se propague entre la población de la cárcel. Tyreese descubre que alguien ha asesinado y quemado los cadáveres de su novia y su amigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl encabeza un grupo que sale de la cárcel en busca de medicamentos y, durante el trayecto, oyen por radio que alguien habla de un santuario. Rick averigua quién asesinó a Karen y David y por qué lo hizo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick y Carol salen en busca de comida y ocurre algo que cambia su relación para siempre. Mientras, el otro grupo sigue buscando medicinas y, durante la misión, Bob le confiesa a Tyreese que es alcohólico.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La salud de los enfermos empeora drásticamente aunque Hershel trate de salvar sus vidas como pueda. Rick revela a Maggie qué ha pasado con Carol, mientras que en las murallas de la prisión una muchedumbre de zombis amenaza con destruir la valla.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras la caída de Woodbury, el Gobernador vaga sin rumbo hasta que encuentra a una familia cuyo patriarca está moribundo. El Gobernador se encariña especialmente con Lilly, una niña autista a la que promete proteger siempre.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador se da cuenta de que el grupo de Martínez es débil, a pesar de que tienen un gran arsenal. Además, localiza a quienes le arrebataron todo lo que tenía.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El Gobernador captura a Hershel y Michonne y exige al grupo salir de la prisión. Sin embargo, Rick y su gente no van a dejarse vencer sin presentar batalla.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Después de la batalla contra el Gobernador, Rick y Carl encuentran una casa en la que Rick intenta reponerse de sus graves heridas y Carl sale en busca de alimentos. Mientras, Michonne trata de encontrarlos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los sobrevivientes del ataque vagan por el bosque, diseminados en grupos pequeños, en busca de cobijo. Tyreese, Lizzie y Mika se topan con una antigua conocida. Mientras, Daryl y Beth buscan a los demás y Glenn despierta en la prisión solo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick, Carl y Michonne se encuentran con un grupo de hombres extremadamente peligrosos en una casa aparentemente vacía. Mientras, Glenn y Tara conocen a unas personas que viajan hacia Washington D. C.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Beth siguen viajando juntos y Beth le revela que no quiere morir sin haber probado nunca el alcohol. A pesar de que Daryl se muestra contrario a sus intenciones, Beth se emborracha y, de esta forma, ambos se conocen mejor.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras buscan Terminus, Maggie, Sasha y Bob discuten fuertemente y terminan separándose, sin percatarse de que son más vulnerables estando solos. Mientras, Daryl y Beth han encontrado cobijo en una funeraria, pero una horda de zombis los ataca.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tyreese, Carol, Lizzie, Mika y Judith llegan a una cabaña mientras buscan Terminus. Allí, Lizzie enloquece y muestra una fascinación por la muerte que hiela la sangre de Carol y Tyreese.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn y Tara se reencuentran con Maggie, Sasha y Bob en un túnel repleto de zombis mientras se aproximan a Terminus. Entretanto, Daryl se ve obligado a viajar con el mismo grupo de hombres que quiere asesinar a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los nuevos amigos de Daryl encuentran a Rick y pretenden violar a Michonne y Carl para después matar a los tres. Mientras, Glenn, Maggie, Sasha, Bob, Tara, Abraham, Eugene y Rosita se dan cuenta de que Terminus no es el paraíso que imaginaron.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Tyreese llegan a las inmediaciones de Terminus y descubren que sus amigos están retenidos y van a ser sacrificados para ser comidos. Ahora, el destino de todo el grupo depende de ellos dos.

programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: Special ID
programme.desc: Chan Chi-Lung est infiltré depuis des années dans le gang triadique hongkongais de Cheung Mo-Hung. Suite à l'échec d'une récente négociation menée par Lung avec les trois autres triades locales pour le compte de Hung, ce dernier commence à douter de son identité. Hung entreprend alors d'éliminer tous les policiers infiltrés de son gang, et nombre d'entre eux sont capturés et tués. Pressentant le danger, Lung demande à son capitaine, Cheung, de mettre fin à sa mission d'infiltration. Cependant, Cheung l'envoie en Chine continentale pour infiltrer un trafic de personnalités protégées . Ce trafic est dirigé par Sunny, le protégé de Hung et ancien camarade de Lung au sein du gang. Cheung promet de rétablir l'identité policière de Lung à la fin de la mission, une fois le trafic de Sunny ruiné. Lung accepte, accompagné de l'inspectrice Fang Jing et de son supérieur, Lei Peng, de la police chinoise. Mais avant qu'ils ne puissent atteindre Sunny, cette dernière disparaît soudainement, laissant Lung sans défense et en grand danger.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: La premiere chevauchee de wyatt earp

programme.title: Jacob, l'homme qui a lutté avec Dieu

programme.title: Le clan des McMasters

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Un capitaine de cavalerie a beaucoup de mal à maintenir la paix entre son colonel tyrannique et un chef indien déterminé à se venger.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
programme.desc: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

programme.title: Maria Bamford: Weakness Is the Brand
programme.desc: Maria Bamford, star of the "Lady Dynamite" TV series, performs standup comedy.

programme.title: Jim Gaffigan: The Pale Tourist - Canadian American
programme.desc: Jim Gaffigan performs in Canada and has some very strong opinions on poutine, Saskatchewan, health care and the pronunciation of the city of Regina.

programme.title: Kellen Erskine: Zoomed Out
programme.desc: Comic Kellen Erskine muses about airports, rollercoasters, dentists and more.

programme.title: Andy Sandford: Shameful Information
programme.desc: From burrito privacy to farting on airplanes, Andy Sandford tackles a vast array of topics.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
programme.desc: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

programme.title: Eddie Griffin: Undeniable
programme.desc: The comic celebrates a 30-year anniversary in comedy by discussing the world, relationships and humanity.

programme.title: Eddie Griffin: You Can Tell Em I Said It
programme.desc: Eddie shares his thoughts on his love for Michelle Obama, God's sense of humor, who really makes up the Tea Party, and why Cleveland should get over LeBron James.

programme.title: Alonzo Bodden: Heavy Lightweight
programme.desc: The comic riffs on topics that include slavery, cellphones, the #MeToo movement, millennials, Kanye West, Taco Bell and Israel.

programme.title: Aries Spears: Comedy Blueprint
programme.desc: Armed with his ferociously aggressive style of comedy, MAD TV alum Aries Spears takes the stage in Philadelphia for 'Comedy Blueprint.' No one - not black, not white, not gay, not straight - is safe from his jokes and impressions.

programme.title: Arnez J: Racially Motivated
programme.desc: A comedy performance by Arnez J at Boston's Wilbur Theater.

programme.title: Dave Foley: Relatively Well
programme.desc: Dave Foley struggles in a world intent on crushing common sense.

programme.title: Josh Blue: Sticky Change
programme.desc: The "Last Comic Standing"-winning comic performs.

programme.title: Josh Blue: Delete
programme.desc: In his hometown of Denver, Josh Blue discusses the daily details of his life.

programme.title: Sarah Hester Ross: Don't Mess With a Redhead
programme.desc: Comedian Sarah Hester Ross shows her life of being TikTok famous.

programme.title: Tom Papa: Human Mule
programme.desc: Comedian Tom Papa returns to Cleveland while relating the everyman struggles of family life, falling behind to the super rich and his hilarious cure for angry young men.

programme.title: Tom Papa: Freaked Out
programme.desc: Papa's comedy special touches on subjects such as the hazards of churches, make-up, loose change, old age, Chinese grocery stores, raising women and magical gnomes.

programme.title: Chris Porter: Ugly and Angry
programme.desc: Chris Porter of Last Comic Standing performs his comedy routine in Kansas City.

programme.title: Chris Porter: A Man From Kansas
programme.desc: Chris Porter discusses everything from hipsters ruining food, to being a man, to playing beer pong with celebrities, in his 3rd one-hour special.

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
programme.desc: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

programme.title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
programme.desc: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

programme.title: Corrupt Crimes
programme.desc: True-crime series are a staple of the TV landscape. "Corrupt Crimes" analyzes recent criminal cases through a combination of expert testimony and dramatic storytelling. From crimes like doping in sports to more serious offenses like murder, the series exposes what is really going on in each case. Exposing corruption across the United States is the goal of the series. programme.title: Connections mit James Burke

programme.title: 112 - Feuerwache Neukölln
programme.desc: Deutschlands älteste Berufsfeuerwehr arbeitet am Limit. Besonders betroffen: der Stadtteil Neukölln. Mehr als 2000 Mal im Monat rücken hier die Retter vom Dienst aus. Die Menschen greifen immer schneller zum Hörer und wählen 112, auch wenn‘s nicht wirklich brennt. Die Arbeit im rauen Bezirk im Zentrum Berlins gilt als besonders fordernd und spannend und zieht deshalb vor allem Feuerwehrleute an.

programme.title: Knochenjobs
programme.desc: Torsten Becker arbeitet als Hufschmied. Während seiner Arbeit am Pferd muss Becker immer auf der Hut sein, denn wenn ihn das Pferd tritt, ist eine Verletzung garantiert. programme.title: Everybody Loves Sunshine
programme.desc: In Manchester's Pepperhill Estate, cousins and gang leaders Ray (Andrew Goth) and Terry (Goldie) have always relied on each other. Ray, tired of gang life and in love with Clare (Rachel Shelley), wants out. But Terry, obsessed with keeping Ray in the gang, won't let him leave. While they're in prison, the Chinese Triad kills a gang member. As revenge looms, aging gangster Bernie (David Bowie) struggles to maintain peace.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff

programme.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin

programme.title: Big Ass Spider!

programme.title: Monsters in the Closet

programme.title: Uncaged

programme.title: Bad Milo

programme.title: The Golem

programme.title: The Mimic

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: The investigation into a newlywed's murder starts with a widow and ends with a possible serial killer.

programme.title: Dateline NBC

programme.title: Dateline NBC

programme.title: Dateline NBC

programme.title: Dateline NBC
programme.desc: A romantic Mediterranean cruise intended to rekindle the love between a woman and her ex-husband leads to her vanishing; the investigation reveals secret recordings, a surprising star witness and an undercover hit man.

programme.title: Dateline NBC

programme.title: Dateline NBC

programme.title: Dateline NBC

programme.title: Dateline NBC

programme.title: Dateline NBC

programme.title: Dateline NBC

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Manny’s crush on Craig has reached huge proportions and everyone’s urging her to ask him out already! But Manny’s a romantic; she thinks the guy ought to do the asking

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Grade Nine International Day is coming up and Hazel isn’t thrilled. After all, Hazel’s Jamaican and everybody loves the islands - right? When the day arrives, Hazel’s display is a hit, but she isn’t acting like herself.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Emma Nelson is reveling in her newest job as her mom's maid of honour and planner extraordinaire! Her mom, Spike, is marrying her high-school crush, Snake - who also just happens to be Emma's favourite teacher.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Emma Nelson is reveling in her newest job as her mom's maid of honour and planner extraordinaire! Her mom, Spike, is marrying her high-school crush, Snake - who also just happens to be Emma's favourite teacher.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Marco and Ellie are the best of friends. But Ellie is starting to want more…Marco though can’t seem to respond in kind. He’s more and more confused about what and who he’s looking for…..

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: When class clown JT acts up in Science class, his teacher Ms. Hatzilakos gives him a serious detention - assisting her with the guinea pigs all week. JT’s annoyed, but he perks up when his friends point out that he’s getting alone time with the best looking teacher in school.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Things are looking up for Sean. He and Emma are back together. He’s a star on the basketball team.And he and Jimmy have buried the hatchet. Jimmy’s even invited him to a party. But the good feelings don’t last for long.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Liberty can’t believe it when she doesn’t make the Girls Floor Hockey team – she’s never failed at anything. So when Coach Hatzilakos asks her to be the Team Manager, Liberty throws all her energy into managing.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Ashley and Jimmy are back together, but it doesn’t feel quite the same. Ash may not look the same as last year – she’s a Goth now – but Jimmy’s sure she’s still the same golden girl inside.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Emma’s mom is away for a few days and it’s just her and her step-dad, Mr. Simpson. He’s supportive of Emma’s involvement in “Food for Thought”; the student group who wants to remove genetically modified (GM) foods from the school cafeteria.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: After being in counselling for a long time, Paige is positive she’s recovered from her date rape. In fact, she’s convinced her life is back to normal – Dean and what he did are behind her forever. She never wants to see him again, so she’s dismissive.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: It’s exam time and everyone’s stressed – especially Craig. In a surprise visit from his father, Craig learns that his dad is very eager to have him back in his life.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Although his father is gone, Craig wants to get on with his life as normal. He insists on going back to school immediately and becomes frustrated with his friends when they behave with concern.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The pending birth a new baby for Spike and Snake inspires Emma to search for her birth father. With some detective work, Emma discovers that her father, Shane, lives just outside the city.

programme.title: Golem, le Tueur de Londres
programme.desc: Le Londres victorien est terrorisé par un tueur en série inconnu qui laisse des messages énigmatiques écrits avec le sang de ses victimes. Lorsque les meurtres se multiplient, Scotland Yard confie l'affaire à un inspecteur célèbre.

programme.title: Pour de mauvaises raisons
programme.desc: An ensemble film about four everyday people: a store manager, a security guard, a fire fighter and a clerk who struggle in the aftermath of trauma.

programme.title: Le Café de l'Amour
programme.desc: La propriétaire d’un café où tout le monde tombe amoureux risque de tout perdre lorsqu’une célébrité fait sa demande en mariage et se fait larguer. Elle décide alors de tout faire pour réconcilier le couple.

programme.title: Les Babysitters
programme.desc: À 17 ans, Shirley Lyner, lycéenne, pense à l'université et gère un service de baby-sitting qui fournit des call-girls adolescentes aux pères de jeunes enfants. Dans un long flashback, nous voyons ce qui l'a amenée à passer du statut de baby-sitter à celui d'organisatrice et de gérante du service. Tout commence avec Michael, le père des enfants dont elle s'occupe. Une tasse de café sur le chemin du retour, une visite nocturne dans une gare de triage, et les choses s'enchaînent. Shirley peut se montrer impitoyable, et la tension monte lorsque certains clients emmènent les filles dans un chalet à la montagne et apportent de la drogue. Puis, l'une des filles tente de se mettre à son compte. Cela peut-il bien se terminer : est-ce une tragédie en devenir ? Avons-nous tous des secrets ?

programme.title: Le Ravisseur
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un policier apparemment exemplaire enlève et emprisonne secrètement une belle danseuse, une bataille mortelle s'engage entre le ravisseur et la captive.

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Un architecte est atteint d'une maladie oculaire qui l'introduit dans une réalité surréaliste dans laquelle il voit les motivations des gens. Les visions devenant intolérables, il tombe amoureux d'une femme mystérieuse.

programme.title: Divorce et je te tuerai
programme.desc: Lorsque son ex-mari revient dans sa vie, Josie se retrouve mêlée à un divorce compliqué avec son ex-épouse actuelle, Laura, qui semble déterminée à faire de la vie un enfer pour elle et tous ceux qui l'entourent.

programme.title: Une Pluie sans Fin
programme.desc: Un homme licencié d'une aciérie veut désespérément traquer un tueur en série dans une petite ville du sud de la Chine.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker voyagent à travers l'Angleterre dans leur vieux camping-car pour voir leurs amis, leur famille et des lieux du passé. Depuis le diagnostic de démence de Tusker, leur temps ensemble le plus précieux de tous.

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Amoureux pour le Show
programme.desc: Suit l’histoire de Tara Thompson, dont la carrière de présentatrice commence à stagner. Elle accepte de participer à une émission télévisée pour épouser son partenaire idéal , Joe, un homme qu’elle n’a jamais rencontré. Mais en secret, elle tente de le retrouver pour clarifier que le mariage n’est que pour...

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues

programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... all the waters that were in the river [Nile] were turned to blood. And all the fish that was in the river died,” reports the Bible, “and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river.” (Exodus 7:20–21).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… so there were lice upon man, and upon beast,” reports the Bible, “all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.” (Exodus 8:18, 17). Even today, two million people die every year from malaria transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly in Africa.

programme.title: Genocide 1942-1944
programme.desc: Treblinka, Belzec Majdanek and Sobibor - the camps of "Operation Reinhardt," a Nazi murder campaign that took nearly two million lives within a few months in 1942/43.

programme.title: Armageddon 1943-1945
programme.desc: After the defeat of Stalingrad, the Nazis plan a kind of extended suicide on a global scale. Denunciations from the population ensure that the Gestapo can suppress almost any resistance.

programme.desc: Warships secured the river borders formed by the Rhine and the Danube. The palisades, walls, trenches and forts of the Limes on land stretched across Germania, the wild "Barbaricum." The Limes was a bulwark that ran from northern Britain all the way to the Black Sea.

programme.title: The Limes, Season 1
programme.desc: Was the Limes Rome’s "iron curtain", its bulwark against the barbarians? Along the Limes military camps evolved into flourishing villages, protected by an impressive boundary and the Roman legions. But how endangered were these cities? How did the Limes hold against the attacks from tribes from the north?

programme.title: Germany in Ruins
programme.desc: March 6, 1945. Cologne is the first major German city to fall to the Allies. Stalin plans to conquer Berlin before the other Allies arrive.

programme.title: Downfall and Liberation
programme.desc: April 16, 1945. The Red Army begins its offensive on Berlin. The first concentration camps have been liberated by British and US forces, who discovered emaciated prisoners and corpses.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler’s Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity’s original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler’s “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E09 - Ethiopia - Dances With Bulls
programme.desc: Scott and Justin meet up with Robel, who takes the guys to visit his sisters in his village of Harar. They visit the bustling chat market, and learn how to prepare the traditional stimulant. That night, Robel takes them to feed some wild hyenas by hand. Leaving Harar, they take a long drive to visit the Hammer Tribe. Here they witness a rare ceremony in which the women of the village offer themselves to be whipped, and one soon-to-be married man has to run, stark naked over a dozen bulls, to prove his worth as a husband.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Rwanda is a country emerging from its darkest years of poaching and the 1994 genocide. Scott and Justin travel with locals to learn more about how Rwanda is managing today. They explore the recovery of the animal population – from swimming cows on Napoleon Island to trekking into the wild to visit isolated groups of mountain gorillas. This experience is contrasted with a visit to the church of Ntarama to talk to a genocide survivor, and a court tribunal of several accused men. The guys hear stories of forgiveness from the people, and learn of their hope for their country.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The guys arrive in the arctic destination at the beginning of winter. With only six hours of sunlight a day, they experience an entirely different type of adventure. Arriving by helicopter into the town of Ittoqqortoormiit, they take part in a seat hunt, and learn of the many ways people survive in this harsh arctic climate. With some basic training under their belt, the team heads off on a three-day trek to the abandoned ghost town of Cape Hope, where weather and extreme conditions pushes everyone’s utmost limits.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E12 - North Korea - The Other Side
programme.desc: Scott and Justin are prepared for perhaps their greatest adventure to date, providing them with a rare glimpse inside the borders of this isolated country. From Beijing, they depart to Pyongyang with an Englishman named Nick – an outsider with unprecedented access to the country. Meeting up with their local guides, Chae and Kim, the team visits many historical and political sights, learning the local perspective on world events, and gaining a much greater understanding of the country. An evening cruise down the Taedong River begins to cement a solid friendship between the guys and their guides.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E13 - North Korea - The Musical
programme.desc: North Koreans are a fiercely proud and creative people. North Korea continues to completely defy all expectations, as Scott and Justin take part in a high school English class, are pulled into numerous musical performances, visit a water bottling factory, a farm and an old funfair. Their experiences are capped off by the largest and most impressive choreographed spectacle on earth – the Arirang Mass Games – where 100,000 people perform the ultimate homage to their country and ideologies. The guys are sad to leave their trusted guides and friends behind when they depart by train back to Beijing.

programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E14 - Indonesia - Ring Of Fire
programme.desc: The trip begins on the caldera of Mount Bromo - an active, yet serene volcano in the middle of the island of Java. With their local friend Oka, they continue to the slums of Jakarta, meeting with a young boy and his family, and participating in daily activities to learn of the many hardships facing the locals. Heading to the island paradise of Bali, they take part in an explosive, traditional bull race. Scott gets “dirty” while Oka loses his chariot altogether. The trip winds down when they meet a Balinesian Prince, and join his party as guests of honour.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E15 - Indonesia - A Home Away
programme.desc: For three years, Scott and Justin have travelled the globe, experiencing so many people’s homes, while getting further away from their own. In their friend Oka’s home island of Bali, the guys witness both spiritual and illegal aspects of Balinesian life - grand temples, noisy bird markets and betting on underground cricket fights. They then travel back in time to the island of Sumba, staying overnight with a tribe who live in close harmony with nature and their ancestors. While Justin ponders returning home, Scott realizes that after three years on the road, there are more similarities between people and cultures than differences.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: From the southern coast of Adelaide, all the way to Darwin, the guys take on another road trip - this time with their own purchased 4x4 to get them through the perilous, dusty outback. Fighting constant breakdowns, they reach the underground town of Coober Pedy, where they search for opal with the help of an explosives “expert”. The crew travel from Uluru, staying on a working ranch, before tackling the ultimate off-road adventure through searing sand to remote Boggy Hole. Pushing on through a sudden rainstorm in the north, to the last miles to Darwin, Scott, Justin, and Andre have now travelled to all seven continents. What’s next?

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Dropped S2 - "Valley of Snow"

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "WIN SOME,LOSE SOME"

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S1 - "FAMILY TIES"

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "WOMEN POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In Hyderabad, Indien, existieren Reichtum und Armut Tür an Tür. Täglich sind 15.000 Polizisten im Einsatz gegen Kriminalität – von Diebstahl bis hin zu religiös motivierter Gewalt. In Palästina stehen 8.500 Polizeikräfte vor noch größeren Herausforderungen. In einem zersplitterten, politisch heiklen Gebiet birgt jeder Einsatz unkalkulierbare Risiken.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "MEDITERRANEAN - HARBOUR POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In Katalonien hat die Regionalpolizei die Zuständigkeit von Spaniens Nationalpolizei übernommen und setzt auf eine schnelle Motorradstaffel zur Bekämpfung städtischer Kriminalität. In Haifa, der bedeutenden Hafenstadt Israels, arbeiten Polizisten unter strengen Vorschriften in einer Umgebung, die von Terrorgefahr und regionalen Konflikten geprägt ist.

programme.desc: Guido (Filippo Timi), un ancien policier, est un vétéran malchanceux des speed-datings à Turin. Mais, à sa grande surprise, il rencontre Sonia (Ksenia Rappoport), une immigrée slovène qui travaille comme femme de chambre dans un hôtel de luxe. Entre eux, le courant passe et une romance passionnée naît. Après avoir quitté la ville pour une escapade romantique à la campagne, les choses prennent soudainement une tournure sombre. Le passé trouble de Sonia refait surface et sa réalité commence à s’effondrer. Tout change dans sa vie : des questions surgissent et les réponses n’arrivent qu’au fil de rebondissements qui tiennent le spectateur en haleine jusqu’aux dernières minutes du film. LA DOUBLE HEURE, lauréat du prix de la meilleure actrice à la Mostra de Venise 2009, est réalisé par Giuseppe Capotondi.

programme.desc: The next generation of Earth observation satellites are now in place maintaining the continuity of long-term climate data. Scientists are concerned the rate is increasing beyond expectations and glacier melting continues unabated.

programme.desc: As NASA prepares to send astronauts to the moon, private space companies are becoming more involved with missions in low-earth orbit. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at SpaceX, a private company that has exceeded expectations.

programme.desc: Did you know that the coldest place in our solar system is an area on our moon? Host Emily Calandrelli takes a look at the planets and moons in our solar system that are extremely inhospitable.

programme.desc: Emily Calandrelli looks at the history of robots that NASA has sent to Mars, including the very first rover, Sojourner. In 2020, NASA launched the most sophisticated rover yet, Perseverance, which will uncover many more mysteries of the Red Planet.

programme.desc: Is there proof that aliens are visiting our planet? What is behind these UFO sightings? Host Emily Calandrelli searches for the truth by interviewing experts and visiting Roswell, New Mexico, the site where some believe aliens once landed.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E09 - Ethiopia - Dances With Bulls
programme.desc: Scott and Justin meet up with Robel, who takes the guys to visit his sisters in his village of Harar. They visit the bustling chat market, and learn how to prepare the traditional stimulant. That night, Robel takes them to feed some wild hyenas by hand. Leaving Harar, they take a long drive to visit the Hammer Tribe. Here they witness a rare ceremony in which the women of the village offer themselves to be whipped, and one soon-to-be married man has to run, stark naked over a dozen bulls, to prove his worth as a husband.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Rwanda is a country emerging from its darkest years of poaching and the 1994 genocide. Scott and Justin travel with locals to learn more about how Rwanda is managing today. They explore the recovery of the animal population – from swimming cows on Napoleon Island to trekking into the wild to visit isolated groups of mountain gorillas. This experience is contrasted with a visit to the church of Ntarama to talk to a genocide survivor, and a court tribunal of several accused men. The guys hear stories of forgiveness from the people, and learn of their hope for their country.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E01 - Costa Rica
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore Zunya, an eco-village, and its enchanting blue zone concept. We delve into communal living, uncovering its allure. At La Senda, we experience soul cleansing Temazcal and a sublime cacao ceremony. We engage in a farm-to-table activity, savouring locally sourced ingredients. Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The guys arrive in the arctic destination at the beginning of winter. With only six hours of sunlight a day, they experience an entirely different type of adventure. Arriving by helicopter into the town of Ittoqqortoormiit, they take part in a seat hunt, and learn of the many ways people survive in this harsh arctic climate. With some basic training under their belt, the team heads off on a three-day trek to the abandoned ghost town of Cape Hope, where weather and extreme conditions pushes everyone’s utmost limits.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.desc: Marilia's transformative Bali journey unfolded with cultural immersion and healing escapades. Tirta Empul temple brought purification and Wira's guidance. She relished nature's power at Tibumana waterfall and swung on Balinese swings. Mr. Ketut's healing, coconut blessings, and palm readings soothed her soul. The Yoga Barn's water healing session, blending watsu and dance, transported her to new realms. Serenity embraced her through local cuisine, scenic vistas, and Brian's violin melodies. Engaging with Balinese traditions, she crafted temple offerings and explored coconut oil production. Bingin Beach's natural beauty inspired reflection, while Uluwatu Surfing Villas hosted her show. A Vespa ride captured precious moments in Uluwatu's enchanting surroundings. Marilia's Bali odyssey: a harmonious blend of culture, healing, and adventure.

programme.title: Travel Man

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E12 - North Korea - The Other Side
programme.desc: Scott and Justin are prepared for perhaps their greatest adventure to date, providing them with a rare glimpse inside the borders of this isolated country. From Beijing, they depart to Pyongyang with an Englishman named Nick – an outsider with unprecedented access to the country. Meeting up with their local guides, Chae and Kim, the team visits many historical and political sights, learning the local perspective on world events, and gaining a much greater understanding of the country. An evening cruise down the Taedong River begins to cement a solid friendship between the guys and their guides.

programme.title: Journey Within

programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E06 - Cape Town
programme.desc: In Cape Town, the journey unfolds, connecting with mentors, experiencing creative breakthroughs, spiritual rituals, and ancestral connections. From this transformative experience, Marilia discovers the power of inner strength and connection.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E13 - North Korea - The Musical
programme.desc: North Koreans are a fiercely proud and creative people. North Korea continues to completely defy all expectations, as Scott and Justin take part in a high school English class, are pulled into numerous musical performances, visit a water bottling factory, a farm and an old funfair. Their experiences are capped off by the largest and most impressive choreographed spectacle on earth – the Arirang Mass Games – where 100,000 people perform the ultimate homage to their country and ideologies. The guys are sad to leave their trusted guides and friends behind when they depart by train back to Beijing.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E07 - Cornwall NB
programme.desc: In this episode, Marilia explores various locations in Cornwall. She visits Boscastle, known for its witch stories, and enjoys ocean views from a field. She also explores Merlin's Cave and meets a life coach named Euan in St Neot. Marilia engages in nature bathing and encounters wildlife while walking towards Muir. At Joe's home and studio, she assists him in painting and enjoys his vinyl covers and guitar music. Marilia learns about animal massage therapy from Jenna and goes on a carriage ride through rural scenery. She joins the Seaweeders for seaweed foraging, visits the drying warehouse, and meets Gemma, an Alexander Technique specialist. Marilia also takes time to relax at a hotel spa, filming her show against the stunning ocean cliff. This episode offers a captivating exploration of Cornwall's landscapes, encounters with talented individuals, and immersive experiences.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E08 - St. Pete NB
programme.desc: Marilia embarks on a captivating journey, capturing the essence of Treasure Island through extraordinary encounters. They film hidden treasures and enchanting allure against stunning backdrops. At Fort DeSoto, Marilia embraces the tranquil beauty of the beach, while Ashley leads them to Boyd Hill National Park for profound conversations beneath a magnificent tree. In Ashley's studio, a tea ceremony symbolizes tranquility and connection, followed by an intimate interview unveiling her artistry. Gulfport Beach becomes a sanctuary for transformative sound healing, and Marilia rides a bike along the boardwalk, capturing the synergy between nature and human activity. Marilia meets Justin, capturing his unique vision and creativity, and encounters Lindy, a captivating sound healer. Dolphin Yoga at CMA merges Marilia's practice with the playful marine world, while Levi guides her through an extraordinary dolphin feeding session. Clearwater Marine Aquarium showcases the dedication of the staff and educates visitors about marine conservation. In Irene's studio, Marilia explores the wellness aspect of Flamenco dance. The journey concludes at Mirror Lake, encapsulating the profound impact of Marilia's experiences through heartfelt testimonials and reflective voice-overs.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E14 - Indonesia - Ring Of Fire
programme.desc: The trip begins on the caldera of Mount Bromo - an active, yet serene volcano in the middle of the island of Java. With their local friend Oka, they continue to the slums of Jakarta, meeting with a young boy and his family, and participating in daily activities to learn of the many hardships facing the locals. Heading to the island paradise of Bali, they take part in an explosive, traditional bull race. Scott gets “dirty” while Oka loses his chariot altogether. The trip winds down when they meet a Balinesian Prince, and join his party as guests of honour.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E09 - Joshua Tree NB
programme.desc: In Joshua Tree, our journey began with Gabi, our knowledgeable astrology expert, who gracefully guided us through the mesmerizing wonders of the full moon, mercury retrogrades, and the celestial constellations. We then found ourselves immersed in the transformative realm of sound healing, led by the enchanting melodies of Alchemy. Marilia experienced profound rejuvenation as her body, mind, and soul were harmonized by the ethereal vibrations of diverse instruments.

programme.title: Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E10 - L.A. NB
programme.desc: In the LA episode, our journey began with an awe-inspiring hike alongside the wolves. Wolf Connection revealed the magical nature of these animals and sparked a conversation about the connection between women and wolves. We then delved into Ayurveda, learning from Jay about the presence of nature in our bodies and how to maintain balance. Karla, an Ayurvedic chef, treated us to a delightful meal while emphasizing the importance of food for our well-being. Marilia fearlessly took a leap from an airplane, showing us how extreme sports can free us from fear. Lastly, Tracy showcased her life and passion for WCMX at the skate park, highlighting the joy found in pursuing our passions.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E15 - Indonesia - A Home Away
programme.desc: For three years, Scott and Justin have travelled the globe, experiencing so many people’s homes, while getting further away from their own. In their friend Oka’s home island of Bali, the guys witness both spiritual and illegal aspects of Balinesian life - grand temples, noisy bird markets and betting on underground cricket fights. They then travel back in time to the island of Sumba, staying overnight with a tribe who live in close harmony with nature and their ancestors. While Justin ponders returning home, Scott realizes that after three years on the road, there are more similarities between people and cultures than differences.

Pushing on through a sudden rainstorm in the north, to the last miles to Darwin, Scott, Justin, and Andre have now travelled to all seven continents. What’s next?

programme.desc: Marilia had a memorable trip to Malaysia. She visited Christine's Dog Sanctuary, played with dogs, and discussed animal preservation. Acro yoga with Sasa and friends brought laughter. Dr. Lee provided acupuncture sessions and explained meridian points. They met at the Ruma Hotel with stunning views of Kuala Lumpur. Marilia gathered flowers and spices at Urban Nomads Garden with Janice, who prepared a delightful coconut soup and salad. Marilia met Justin Chea, director of Kechara Soup Kitchen, and volunteered for food preparation and distribution. Filming and reflection took place at Independence Square. The trip ended with relaxation by the pool and a refreshing swim, appreciating the hotel's architecture and views. Marilia's journey in Malaysia was diverse, including animal care, wellness, culinary exploration, volunteerism, and self-reflection, making it truly memorable.

programme.desc: New international players enter the game as the war expands beyond Dallas. With trust shattered and power shifting, one truth becomes unavoidable – this battle is far from finished.

programme.title: What She Wants
programme.desc: Vannaleese Poole is a street smart, businesswoman who knows how to use what she has to get what she wants. In Her relentless thirst to make major moves, she hooks up with Jay, a big time street boss, who promises her the world, but only if she follows the rules that she isn’t willing to play by. She meets Brint, a business mogul, who falls hard for her and gives her everything she wants. A test of love will introduces her to something she never knew she wanted.

programme.title: Boss Moves
programme.desc: When Lena coerces her husband, Crutch, to betray, Kane, best friends become sworn enemies. Locked in a deadly battle of mind games, nothing is as it seems, so make your next move your best move, because it could be your last.

programme.title: Black Girl Magic
programme.desc: Fall under the spell of these five hilariously talented black women from all walks of life, and all parts of the U.S., in this side splitting stand-up special. Starring NY's Brooklyn Jones, LA's Alycia Cooper, Chicago's Just Nesh, Milwaukee's Kelly Kellz and hosted by Atlanta's Ashima Franklin. Filmed on location live from Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.

programme.title: Clutch
programme.desc: Detectives Clutch and Angel navigate a criminal underworld with the help of three women, whom Clutch is familiar with, to solve the disappearance of a group of women. Their investigations take them deeper into unknown and even more corrupt places in the underworld, that are worse than they thought.

programme.title: Deadly Housewife
programme.desc: Florence is a housewife who yearns for something new and exciting in her love life. Things turn deadly real quick when she doesn’t get what she wants.

programme.title: 10 Kilos in the Trunk
programme.desc: Tonya needs to make some quick cash for the holidays, and takes a job transporting cocaine. On the way to the drop-off, her car breaks down in the middle of nowhere. While walking to a gas station for help, she is stopped by a police officer, and arrested for several warrants. Now in jail, Tonya, gets her friend Monica to make the delivery. Monica must get the car fixed, avoid a thief looking to steal the product, and make the delivery by the deadline or both will face deadly consequences.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: After an argument with her emotionally abusive step-father, a smart 19-year-old woman from rural Georgia hastily moves to Atlanta with hopes of staying with a friend. Motivated by the social justice movement of 2020, she wants to work for Stacy Abrams and register people to vote. After an argument with her friend, she finds herself suddenly homeless and must survive on the mean streets of Atlanta by any means necessary.

programme.title: Fractured
programme.desc: When a woman stumbles upon undeniable proof of her husband's infidelity, reality takes an unexpectedly bizarre turn and the truth becomes stranger than fiction. This thrilling narrative is skillfully woven through the perspectives of multiple characters. With each character's viewpoint, fresh layers of information are unveiled, gradually unraveling a shocking twist that will leave viewers stunned, defying all expectations.

programme.title: Kill em with a Smile
programme.desc: Happily married Jessica has accepted that she is going to die from a terminal illness, and isn’t afraid of death. Her real fear however, is her husband Reginald falling back in love with his ex Rebecca, and stealing the life she built.

programme.title: I Hate I Love You
programme.desc: Jacinda and Bradley Wright are Managing Partners of a media company. Over the past year, they have enjoyed unprecedented success, but it comes with a price. From betrayal to illegal activity, both love and business are being destroyed by motives that cause everyone to have an agenda and everyone to have something to gain or lose. The old saying “Keep your Friends close and your enemies closer” are the truest words one can ever speak.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: Fatal Promises
programme.desc: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. When his lies and betrayal begin to surface, Renae turns to Eric, a loyal longtime friend, and together their search for truth spirals into obsession, revenge, and deadly consequences.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.desc: When a cop murders and rapes a woman, he puts the blame on a local man who must prove his innocence.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A disused airfield at Cooper's Cross is where Simon Bright's vintage car is found by Frances Kirby. Inside she finds Simon dead, as the evening before his death had been on a romantic date with his girlfriend Laura Sharp. Laura is nowhere to be found, both Barnaby and Jones, newly promoted to DS, need to work out if it was a suicide pact gone wrong or whether it was murder and track down Laura.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters. She receives a real shock, when she discovers that Rex's friends had been told she had died in a plane crash. Things become complicated when Rex's body is found in the nearby river. Barnaby and Jones quickly turn up trying to workout who would wish Rex harm. Several friends of Rex come forward with multiple 'new' wills each being sole beneficiary.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst on a business trip to China, Alan King suddenly dies. The family firm, King's Crystal is in financial uncertainty, including plans to close its factory in Midsomer Magna. Six months later Alan's widow Hilary and his brother Charles are married, much to the chagrin of Alan's son Ian. With family feuds and factory workers angered by the loss of their jobs, there's many motives in the mix. When Peter Baxter, the firm's accountant is found dead, stabbed with a Masonic dagger.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Rocks festival is due to take place and music fans descend on neighbouring fields to enjoy the fiesta. The recently reformed band Hired Gun, are one of the headline acts and during their opening performance, the bands vocalist Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage whilst holding on to her microphone stand, that had an added mystery wire. Barnaby and Jones soon discover other band members could be targets.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When popular GP, Doctor Alan Delaney borrows fellow Dr. James Kirkwood's new car to do an evening call-out. He is mysteriously killed in a hit and run during a drive through woods in a thunderstorm. Barnaby and Jones start investigating in Midsomer Market and discover that James may have been the intended victim. The case leads them to North Walesformer home of Delyth Mostyn, James's fiance to delve further.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the pretty village of Luxton Deeping, there's fierce conflict between the traditional film and modern digital photographers. When their societies committee decide not to accept digital images at the annual photographic exhibition, it appears to make things worse. It leads to a confrontation at the private view. The following day Lionel Bell is found murdered in woodland, strangled with the cord of his light meter.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The inhabitants of Midsomer Magna are in the spotlight, quite literally when a production crew descend on the village and imposing Manor House. To film a version of The Scarlet Pimpernel. Not only the film crew arrive, but a notorious criminal as well, George Ince, lurking around the Manor. When Nick Cheney, the film's director is found dead, by the use of the prop guillotine. The detectives need to sift through many motives which lead to the complexity.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Holm, a rehabilitation scheme for reformed criminals continues. When Ronnie Tyler departs, he gets a good send off from everyone, including DCI Barnaby. Another attendee is Jack Colby, a disgraced ex-policeman and former colleague of Barnaby. Jack is decidedly frosty towards his once-former friend and refuses to chat. When Jack is later murdered, Barnaby must search for answers in Jack's past for motives.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Down at the prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club, there is much rivalry and snobbery amongst its members. When Alistair Kingslake is coerced into the thicket to look for his ball on the notorious 13th hole, known as Crisp's Folly, he soon gets bludgeoned to death. There's many suspects, from fellow members, several villagers who only have limited time on the course and the club's staff. It is not long before another member is found stabbed in woodland close to the course.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a newly discovered treasure by the 19th-century landscape artist Henry Hogson, makes an impression, it is later sold at auction for 400,000. Shortly after the previous owner of the artwork is tortured and killed. The following day another Hogson is stolen in a burglary and Barnaby finds himself having to investigate both. In order to get success, he needs to become an expert on Hogson with the help of art teacher Matilda Simms, they uncover many hidden secrets, deception and more.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Former secret agent Geoffrey Larkin arrives in the village of Midsomer Parva and heads for a visit to Allenby House, a country manor run by former spies, the Frazer family as a safe house. With an air of hostility towards Geoffrey, it is not long before he is murdered, by some who blame the 'beast of Midsomer', who believe the creature exists. Barnaby, a former spy himself, gets involved in the case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: George Jeffers, a professor of Midsomer University and cycling enthusiast, threatens to go public, he is found with his state-of-the-art invention Kernel Logic. This angers American software boss Clinton Finn and fears he will lose millions if the truth is exposed. When schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed in a hit and run, things become more complicated. With someone known as 'the Bucketman' throwing red paint over cars belonging to employees of a local computer firm, among others.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In Little Worthy, model maker Bob Moss was just going to open his beloved model village, when he stumbled across the body of young Richard Tanner. He had been stabbed and his corpse tied down like Gulliver in the stories of Lilliput. Barnaby and Jones start questioning all the villagers and discover many quirky characters in the process. When the girl Richard was secretly meeting in the grounds of the model village, is murdered during the Crazy Craft Race.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A cat burglar known as 'the Creeper' could be responsible for murder, not just burglaries. When a writer friend David Roper is found smothered in bed on the Chettham family estate, a few days after arriving. The police soon learn that Mr Roper had been planning to write a book that could have exposed many Chettham family secrets of years past. That would make someone quiet uneasy and edgy. The mystery deepens when a second victim who knew the family is shot in woodland.

programme.desc: Wir fahren mit dem McLaren 570S Spider ein wenig durchs Gebirge und geniessen den schönen Tag.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Als dem Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg der Like-Button (damals noch der „Awesome-Button“) präsentiert wird, reagiert er mit einem entschiedenen Nein. Sein Team kann ihn jedoch überzeugen und verändert damit die Online-Kommunikation für immer.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: 1967 erschafft der Designer Robert Probst die erste Arbeitswabe, den ersten so genannten "Cubicle" und nennt sie „Action Office“. Eine Utopie, die das Potential des modernen Arbeitnehmers ausschöpfen soll. Doch die Utopie wird zur Dystopie.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Alles beginnt mit ein paar Strichen im Sand. 1948 experimentieren die Studenten Bernard Silver und Norman Joseph Woodland mit frühen Formen der Strichcode-Technologie. Der von ihnen erfundene Strichcode revolutioniert den Welthandel.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: In den 1920er Jahren verwandeln Investoren Florida von einer sumpfigen Provinzgegend in ein nobles Urlaubsparadies. Immobilienspekulationen und das Erschließen von immer mehr Land führen zu Floridas erster Immobilienblase, die 1926 platzt.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Mauvein, der erste synthetischen Farbstoff der Welt, fasziniert die Menschen auf der ganzen Welt, hält in der Modeindustrie Einzug, lässt Lebensmittel appetitlicher aussehen und erlaubt erstaunliche Fortschritte in der Medizin.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: 1841 gelingt dem 12-jährigen Sklave Edmond Albius die erste manuelle Bestäubung der wertvollen Gewürzvanille. Danach tritt die Vanille auf der ganzen Welt ihren Siegeszug an und löst in Sachen künstliche Aromen eine Revolution aus.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Der Hollywood-Star Hedy Lamarr entwickelt während des Zweiten Weltkriegs das Frequenzsprungverfahren, ein sicheres Kommunikationssystem für Torpedos. Heute dient Lamarrs Erfindung als Grundlage für Mobilfunk-Technologien wie WiFi oder GPS.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: In den frühen Tagen des Internets werden Videonutzer von niedriger Auflösung und langen Pufferzeiten geplagt. Doch das „Content Delivery Network“ oder CDN revolutioniert das Streamen von Videos und legt den Grundstein für das Netflix-Zeitalter.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Mit dem „Federal Aid Highway Act” von 1956 ruft der amerikanische Präsident Dwight D. Eisenhower ein gewaltiges Infrastrukturprojekt ins Leben. Jeder Winkel Amerikas soll mit Autobahnen erschlossen werden, um die Nachkriegswirtschaft anzukurbeln.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: In Menlo Park, dem vermutlich ersten Forschungs- und Entwicklungszentrum der Welt, wird der Akt des Erfindens neu gedacht. Was seit Jahrhunderten als eine Solo-Aktivität gilt, wird nun zu Teamarbeit.

programme.title: Breakthrough
programme.desc: Die Entdeckung eines Dinosaurierfossils, das so gut erhalten ist, dass es die Struktur, die Muster und die Farben eines prähistorischen Riesen zeigt. Entdecken Sie eine brandneue Spezies, die in der späten Jura- und in der Kreidezeit lebte.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Die Stunt Heroes machen sich auf den Weg in ein Skigebiet im Oberbergischen Land. Zwischen den Bäumen im verschneiten Wald soll ein Auto explodieren, während ein Stuntman vom explodierenden Auto wegfliegt. Warum das Ganze? Weil eine Armee weißgekleideter Soldaten die Stunt Heroes angreift.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Die Stunt Heroes der Action Concept sind in ein Skigebiet gefahren um dort einen Stunttest unter extremen Bedingungen durchzuführen. Ein Kombi wird mit einer Stempelkanone 50m weit ins Feld geschleudert. Wenn alles gut geht, crasht er dabei in ein hochfliegendes Auto. Die Stunt Heroes von Action Concept lassen es mal wieder ordentlich krachen!

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Wann immer beim Film Menschen durch die Luft fliegen, auf den Boden krachen, vor das Auto laufen oder vom Dach stürzen, braucht man harte Männer und Frauen, die die gefährlichen Szenen für die Schauspieler übernehmen. Das Bodystunt-Special zeigt die Highlights aus der ersten Staffel der Stunt Heroes, garniert mit den besten Fails und Outtakes.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Überschläge, Rampensprünge, Crashs: Es gibt 1000 Wege Autos zu zerstören und die Stunt Heroes kennen sie alle! Da es bei vielen Stunts auf die perfekte Beherrschung des Automobils ankommt, wird bei den Stunt Heroes häufig für den Ernstfall geübt. Das Special blickt nochmal auf die Car-Highlights der ersten Staffel zurück.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Wo die Stunt Heroes auftauchen, ist Action garantiert! Ob zu Lande oder in der Luft: Hauptsache es knallt und scheppert! Dazu kommt jede Menge Unsinn getreu dem Motto „Effekt vor Logik“. Das Special präsentiert nochmals die actiongeladenen Stuntvideos aus der ersten Staffel der Stunt Heroes sowie weitere Highlights.

programme.title: Rolls Royce Wraith: Der Rolls für den selbst fahrenden Superreichen
programme.desc: Rolls Royce ist bekannt dafür, das Beste in der Automobilbranche noch 2x besser und luxuriöser zu machen. Mit dem Wraith soll genau der liquide Kunde angesprochen werden, der sein Auto am liebsten selbst fahrt. Und das ist vollends gelungen.

programme.title: DS 3 Fahrbericht 2019
programme.desc: Frankreich will im Automobilbau zu alter Größe finden. Chic und Luxuriös wollen sie wieder sein. Der DS3 Crossback soll die deutschen Premium-Konkurrenz das Fürchten lehren.

programme.title: Porsche 550 RS Spyder

programme.title: Mercedes AMG C 63 S Cabrio

programme.title: Amphicar 770

programme.title: Der ultimative Porsche-Geheimtipp: Boxster 718 GTS

programme.title: Made in...

programme.title: Made in...
programme.desc: Inzwischen hat Audi rund 16 000 Sportwagen weltweit verkauft. 2010 entschließt man sich noch eins draufzulegen. Eine auf 333 Stück limitierte Sonderserie. programme.title: Made in...

programme.desc: Italienische Sportwagen gelten nicht zu Unrecht als Krone dieser Fahrzeugklasse. Ferrari, Maserati, Lamborghini, Alfa Romeo - kennt praktisch jeder. Aber Iso Rivolta? Im Sarasota Classic Car Museum, Florida finden sich gleich mehrere mit amerikanischen Corvette V8-Motoren ausgerüstete Rivoltas aus der Feder des legendären intalienischen Designers und Tillmann wird vom Rivolta-Enkel Renzo zu einer Ausfahrt im wunderbaren Grifo GT eingeladen. Seulement 3500 unités ont été produites. Mais celui-ci se distingue encore plus du nombre déjà très réduit. C'est le reflex le plus cher du monde.

programme.desc: O Porsche Cayman GT4. Mais leve, mais potente e mais rápido do que nunca. O Porsche mostra o que é possível com este veículo, quando os rápidos tempos de volta estão no centro das atenções.

programme.desc: A paisagem sueca é caracterizada por montanhas, florestas e estradas solitárias. Ideal para este off-roader. O Volvo XC60 pontua com muitas características de segurança e uma aparência fresca.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the Ghibli, the Italian sports car manufacturer Maserati advanced into a more affordable market segment in order to attract a new clientele. But the competition, namely the BMW 5 series, Mercedes-Benz' E-Class, the Audi A6 or Jaguar's XF model, is strong. In addition: taking the Maserati GranCabrio MC on a cruise through the Alps.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Dê uma olhada nos modelos híbridos mais acessíveis. Os pioneiros são definitivamente os japoneses, que têm um monte de carros para oferecer.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Italien ist das Land der Mode, des Designs und der aufregendsten Autos der Welt. Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati und Alfa Romeo gelten als Paradebeispiel für atemberaubende Autos mit tollen Formen, rassigen Motoren und unvergleichlicher Leidenschaft.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.sub-title: Os fabricantes de carros mais antigos
programme.desc: Os dez fabricantes de automóveis mais antigos. Em quem você pensa ser o pioneiro. Nos últimos anos, um número substancial de fabricantes de automóveis comemorou aniversários.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Aston Martin V12 Vantage S Roadster with its 6-litre V12 engine is probably the most amazing export from the UK. It's the British brand's highest-powered convertible of all time. Does it live up to the expectations? In addition: a mountain cruise from dawn to dusk with the Corvette C7 Convertible.

programme.title: Apollo 3500 GT - Design italien et V8 américain
programme.desc: L'Apollo 3500 GT se voulait une alternative aux voitures de sport européennes dont l'entretien était souvent coûteux à l'époque. Une Ferrari américaine, propulsée par un moteur américain : un V8.

programme.title: Porsche 911 992 Turbo - Das Maß der Dinge im Sportwagen-Segment
programme.desc: Der Neue muss alles besser können. Und so ist es auch beim 992 Turbo. Breiter, länger und mit 580 PS 40 PS stärker als sein Vorgänger. Aber der Turbo kann auch Alltag. Ist er damit weiterhin die unangefochtene Nummer eins?

programme.title: Maserati Gran Turismo Coupé Stradale
programme.desc: La volonté de prendre des risques et la précision sont deux caractéristiques qui ne se reflètent pas seulement dans l'histoire mouvementée de l'entreprise Maserati. La Maserati Gran Turismo les intériorise également de manière étonnante.

programme.title: Ein ganz spezieller Traumwagen: Der Ferrari 458 Speciale
programme.desc: Der 458 Speciale ist eine Fahrmaschine vor dem Herrn. 2,4 Kilogramm pro PS sind eine Ansage an die Sportwagen-Welt. Im Motorvisions-Test lasst er seine Pferde von der Leine.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Hoje em dia, tudo se resume a lendas. Descubra dez carros que não são apenas um simples meio de transporte, mas que conseguiram adquirir um status icônico. Eles influenciaram gerações inteiras.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Allrad macht nur im Gelände Spaß? Keineswegs! Und diese zwei sind der Beweis: Wir checken den neuen Subaru Forester on- und offroad. Und: Diese Allrad-Knallbüchse ist wohl eines der außergewöhnlichsten E-Autos. Fünf Fakten zum Hyundai Ioniq 5 N.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Les supercars italiennes sont les voitures les plus excitantes du monde. Qu’il s’agisse de la Ferrari "La Ferrari", de la Lamborghini Aventador ou de la Pagani Huayra, elles sont les plus belles et les plus rapides au monde, conçues par les designers les plus célèbres. Les supercars italiennes sont des voitures de rêve devenues réalité. DreamCars vous présente ces italiennes à couper le souffle.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche Cayman GT4 combined the best elements that Porsche could offer: the V6 Boxer engine from the 911 Carrera S, the chassis, brake system and aerodynamics from the GT3, and a six-gear transmission. In addition: the Audi R8 V10 plus, an even stronger, lighter and faster version of the original model.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Os departamentos de projeto dos fabricantes de automóveis estão tentando fazer o carro perfeito. E, em sua maioria, carros muito elegantes são o resultado. Mas existem criações que levantam seriamente a questão do gosto de seus designers.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Dawn Convertible
programme.desc: Almost silently, it glides through the night. In front of the driver 12 smoothly-running cylinders are at work, with a power reserve that seems inexhaustible. The Rolls Royce Dawn is a convertible for connoisseurs.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Que l’on parle de l'Aston Martin Vanquish, de la Bentley Continental GT Speed ou de la McLaren P1, les supercars anglaises sont les plus rapides, spectaculaires et magnifiques voitures de sport au monde. En plus de leur puissance, elles ont ce petit quelque chose en plus. Une grâce provenant de leur sublime aérodynamique. DreamCars vous montre les supercars anglaises les plus fascinantes.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Sand, Geröll, Wasser oder Asphalt – Abenteuer gibt es auf jedem Untergrund – wenn man das passende Gefährt hat. Wir testen die ultimativen Fun-Geräte Can-Am Outlander und Maverick R in Portugal und verraten spannende Facts zum Smart #5.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Wraith
programme.desc: The Rolls Royce Wraith is different. It gives the traditional British brand a whole new dynamic.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Tem sido dito que a beleza está nos olhos de quem a vê. Portanto, vamos dar uma olhada mais de perto nos dez carros mais bonitos de todos os tempos.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode we invite you to witness the progress of driver Uwe Nittle as he got ready for qualifying at the Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Un point commun entre la Porsche 918 Spyder, l'Audi R8, la Mercedes AMG GT et la BMW i8 : les supercars allemands sont les plus rapides, spectaculaires et convoitées supercars au monde avec leurs vitesses maximales impressionnantes et leurs moteurs dotés d'une puissance incroyable.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.sub-title: Elektrische G-Klasse und CLA auf dem Timmelsjoch
programme.desc: Wir jagen den Mercedes G 580 EQ auf die verschneite Timmelsjoch Hochalpenstraße und klären alle Vor- und Nachteile des neuen elektrischen Antriebs. Außerdem fahren wir exklusiv im neuen noch getarnten CLA.

programme.title: Top10 Show
programme.desc: Veja a série mais rara de carros. Aqueles que são limitados e exclusivos. Obviamente, isto também aumenta imediatamente a conveniência. Quer seja o Lexus LFA ou o Bugatti Veyron.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The RCN Challenge is the ultimate BMW driving experience. We also paid a visit to the Devils Diner, the track's indoor meeting place for drivers.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Elles sont les voitures les plus excitantes et rapides du monde, construites pour des vitesses au-delà de l’imaginable : les supercars de Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Pagani et Porsche. Les supercars sont comme des Formule Un de route : leur puissance semble défier les lois de la physique. DreamCars vous présente les supercars les plus rapides et les plus spectaculaires.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Rallye-Feeling für die Straße. Der Audi Q8 e-tron edition Dakar ist auf 1000 Stück begrenzt und bietet mit 300 kW genug Leistung für Offroad-Abenteuer. Und: Der Porsche Cayenne Turbo E-Hybrid mit GT-Paket bietet Sportwagen-Power im SUV-Format.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: After the 24-hour race was over we left the Nürburgring and moved to Büren, Germany, where the Raeder Motorsport company is based. They are famous for front-wheel drives with a great performance that put a lot of horsepower to the track.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Tesla Modelo S foi o primeiro sedan premium do mundo que foi desenvolvido do zero como um carro elétrico. Tesla mostrou ao mundo que a eletromobilidade pode ser sexy e que ela funciona. Demos uma olhada mais de perto no Modelo S P85D.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Ein Sportwagen, der auch vor Offroad-Strecken nicht zurückschreckt. Wir testen den Porsche 911 Dakar in einem Steinbruch. Und: Subaru setzt jetzt auch auf Elektroantrieb. Wie gut schlägt sich der Solterra auf der Straße und im Gelände?

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Elles sont les voitures les plus excitantes du monde et c rééent plus de désir que toute autre : les coupés de Maserati, Porsche, Bentley, Mercedes et Rolls Royce. Avec leurs designs extraordinaires et leurs puissants moteurs, les coupés génèrent plus d’émotion que les autres voitures, elles sont l'élégance et l'exclusivité. DreamCars vous montre les coupés de rêve les plus incroyables.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nürburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Coupé Classe S da Mercedes é uma verdadeira obra-prima. Exploramos o que o S 63 AMG Coupe tem a oferecer em comparação com o Bentley Continental e o Rolls Royce Wraith.

programme.title: Book by Cadillac: Escalade, Corvette & Co im Auto-Abo fahren

Alle Autos der Marken Cadillac und Chevrolet zum festen Monatspreis von 1500 Euro. Versicherung, Steuern, Service - alles inklusive. Nur den Sprit muss der Kunde noch selbst bezahlen. Warum der hohe Preis trotzdem fair ist!

programme.title: Rolls Royce Wraith : la Rolls pour les super riches qui se conduisent eux-mêmes.

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: From 2006 to 2012 the German company Artega produced their GT sports car model. Thanks to the know-how of a former Porsche and BMW manager the Artega GT was able to be manufactured in a small series.

programme.title: Avec la McLaren 570 GT à Tenerife
programme.desc: La 570 GT est censée être la première McLaren qui soit non seulement sportive, mais surtout adaptée aux longues distances. Nous testons si cet exercice d'équilibre est réussi.

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Motorcycles

Von Choppern und Cruisern, von Street Fightern und klassischen Bikes von Harleys bis hin zu japanischen Motorrädern - diese Messe bietet etwas für jeden Geschmack und jedes Alter.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
